title: A Court Could Pause Frontier AI
script: A San Francisco court is being asked to stop next-generation AI models. Four nonprofits are suing Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and SpaceX. They want an emergency injunction, until companies can prove humans stay in control. The complaint cites AI-driven cyberattacks and the companies' own admissions that AI could go rogue. Congress has yet to pass legislation governing AI. So the question isn't just can we build it. It's should a court let it keep going?
cta: Follow AI Tested for the AI court fight.
